description:
Get compact details for one Danish parliamentary case, including paginated associated document
            metadata and file IDs for optional extracted document text retrieval.

case_id.description: Case ID from search_cases, search_vote_casts, or vote search related_case.id.

document_limit.description: Maximum number of associated document metadata records to return. Use 0 to omit document items while keeping document counts.

document_offset.description: Offset into the associated document metadata list. Use with document_limit to page through large case document lists.

name: get_case
